_comment: infra/vps/monitoring/monitors.json — versioned source of truth for Phase 76 plan 06's external monitors (D-01/D-02/D-03/D-04). Consumed by infra/vps/scripts/provision-monitors.sh, which is idempotent: re-running it against an already-provisioned account creates nothing new (matched by uptimerobot.friendly_name and healthchecks.name/unique). Never edit a monitor's name here without also renaming/re-provisioning its live counterpart — provisioning matches by name, not by any other field.

uptimerobot._comment: D-04a: app-level, not just Caddy. Chatwoot's /api endpoint (app/controllers/api_controller.rb, pinned v4.18.0) renders {"version":...,"queue_services":redis_status,"data_services":postgres_status}. keyword_type 2 = UptimeRobot alerts when this exact substring is MISSING, which happens if either service reports "failing" (key order in the JSON is fixed by the controller's source, so the substring only appears when both are literally "ok" back to back).

D-04a: app-level. The rendered EspoCRM login page's <head><title> is emitted by the app's client-side loader shell (confirmed live 2026-09-27) — Caddy's own error page (502/504 on backend down) never contains this string, so the keyword distinguishes 'app is actually rendering' from 'Caddy is up but the backend died'.

healthchecks.name: prestigo-backup
healthchecks.desc: D-03: nightly restic->B2 backup dead-man's switch. Pinged by infra/vps/scripts/backup.sh (start/success/fail). ~26h total (24h timeout + 2h grace) before an alert fires for a missed run.

healthchecks.name: prestigo-disk-mem
healthchecks.desc: D-04c: root filesystem >85%, used RAM >90%, or swap >50%. Pinged every 5 minutes by infra/vps/scripts/monitor.sh via prestigo-monitor.timer.

healthchecks.name: prestigo-kvm4-trigger
healthchecks.desc: D-12: 7-day rolling average used RAM exceeds 80% — the automated half of the KVM 2 -> KVM 4 upgrade trigger (the other half, 'a second operator is onboarded', is manual — see runbooks/monitoring.md).

healthchecks.name: prestigo-sidekiq
healthchecks.desc: D-04d: Chatwoot Sidekiq liveness via its own Redis heartbeat (the 'processes' set's newest 'beat' epoch field must be under 60s old). A dead Sidekiq leaves the UI up while email/message processing silently stops.

healthchecks.name: prestigo-espocrm-internals
healthchecks.desc: D-04d (parallel check): EspoCRM's daemon container is running and MariaDB's own healthcheck.sh --connect --innodb_initialized succeeds.

healthchecks.name: prestigo-tls-expiry
healthchecks.desc: D-04b: TLS certificate for chat.rideprestigo.com and crm.rideprestigo.com expires within 14 days, or could not be fetched. Runs on the VPS (not a paid UptimeRobot tier feature) per 76-RESEARCH.md Pattern 3.
